compute.note: CONFLICT: the row's method string is "Symmetric FFN, Relu, 32 features per translation" (and until 2024-07-30 its reference was a parameter file "data/NQS/chain32P_32_1.mpack", varbench/varbench 6e9f6b83), while the script it now links runs nk.models.GCNN with layers = 2, features = 32 and NetKet's default activation reim_selu, not ReLU. The script's network would have 32*1*32 + 32 (DenseSymmFFT) + 32*32*64 + 32 (one DenseEquivariantFFT over the 64-element space group of the 32-site ring: 32 translations x {identity, reflection}) = 66624 real parameters; a one-layer symmetric ReLU FFN as the method string describes would not. parameters is therefore left null and the script's count is only recorded here. samples and iterations are the script's (defaults, unchanged across the program's history) and carry the same doubt. samples = 1024 per optimisation step (MCState n_samples = batch_size; MetropolisLocal with n_chains = batch_size = 1024, one sample per chain per step, each separated by sweep_size = N = 32 proposals (NetKet default), n_discard_per_chain = 0); iterations = 10000 ("--max_step" default=10**4); optimizer SR (VMC_SRt when n_parameters >= n_samples), lr 1e-3. The final energy is then estimated once with estim_size = 1024^2 = 1048576 samples (not an optimisation step). NetKet pinned twice by the program: programs/vmc_netket/requirements.txt "NetKet==3.13.0" and conda_env.yaml "netket=3.11.4"; every NetKet line cited here reads the same at both tags. The energy is older than the script: VarBench's data file listed it with no code link ("TODO: own code", varbench/varbench 0ef1497c and 6e9f6b83, 2024-07-11) until the scripts were added on 2024-07-30 (5047bfd6 RBM, d54f7c01 RNN, 765c5d13 GCNN), which changed only the reference column, so the script documents the settings after the fact, with library versions that may postdate the run.

compute.note: Parameters evaluated: NetKet 3.13.0 Jastrow stores the strictly lower triangle of W, N(N-1)/2 = 32*31/2 = 496 real (float32) weights, which is also what vmc.py prints as n_params (tree_size_real_nonzero). Samples: 1024 per SR step, 1024 chains of length 1, each sample one sweep of 32 single-spin proposals, no discard. Iterations: 10^4 steps (--max_step default). Driver: nk.VMC with nk.optimizer.SR(QGTOnTheFly) (n_parameters < n_samples). After training the energy is estimated from 2^20 samples. stored sigma 0.00053 vs sqrt(stored variance 0.2877156 / 2^20) = 0.00052: consistent with the script's 2^20-sample final estimate (--estim_size default). Provenance: the value entered VarBench in 59e621a (2022-09-13, Dian Wu); the linked script was added to varbench/methods in c686621 (2024-07-30) without the value changing, so the script is the authors' later reconstruction of the baseline, not a log of the run (the same holds for the TFIsing RBM rows, scripts/defects.mjs). The 2^20-sample final estimate is corroborated by the stored sigma; batch size and step count are not independently corroborated. No device or time is recorded (the conda env includes CUDA; the README says a GPU is "usually needed for VMC on larger lattices", which is not a statement about these runs).
